subject: Audit logs & data access evidence request
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@fincobank.com>
Cc: Raj Patel <raj.patel@fincobank.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Audit logs & data access evidence request

Hi Alice / Raj,

Thanks again for taking the time today — really helpful to understand FinCo's compliance needs. Per our discovery, you flagged two core asks we want to follow up on:

1) Audit trail detail: a record of who accessed what (user/service), when (timestamp), and what action was taken (read/export/delete).
2) Export formats and retention: the format(s) you need for export (CSV, JSON, or syslog) and retention windows for retained logs.

Next steps I promised:
- Share a short sample export and field mapping to confirm the columns you need.
- Confirm retention SLA (e.g., 90/180/365 days) and any special PII redaction rules.
- Loop in our security lead for any deeper evidence/questions.

I attached a small sample (audit_log_sample.csv) showing the fields we can provide and a readme. Happy to provide a redacted example if you prefer.

Would you let me know: which export format is preferred, and whether you need per-user identifiers or fully redacted identifiers? Also, is your compliance team available for a quick follow-up next week if we need to run through the evidence?

Best,
Hannah
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com
(415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- audit_log_sample.csv (CSV, 5KB)
- access_evidence_readme.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@fincobank.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>; Raj Patel <raj.patel@fincobank.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Mar 2026 16:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs & data access evidence request

Thanks Hannah — helpful summary. A few clarifications from our side: 

- We need user-level access logs showing identity (SAML subject or internal user id), timestamp (UTC), action (READ, EXPORT, DELETE, MODIFY), resource path, and IP address.
- Preferred export formats: CSV or JSON lines. CSV is easiest for our audit tooling, but JSON is acceptable.
- Retention: we require 365 days, but for certain PII-sensitive accesses we may need a separate flagged retention of 2 years.
- PII handling: we will accept logs with hashed identifiers (SHA-256) as long as you provide the hashing salt management policy.

Can you confirm your current default retention for audit logs and whether exports include IP and user-agent fields? Also, please put Marissa (security@redwood.inference.com) on copy for any SOC2/evidence coordination.

If you can send a redacted export and the readme, we can validate quickly. Happy to set a 30-minute sync early next week if needed.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Director, Compliance | FinCo Bank
alice.nguyen@fincobank.com

[Quoted text hidden]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@fincobank.com>; Raj Patel <raj.patel@fincobank.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 08:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs & data access evidence request

Thanks Alice — looping Marissa (Security) and Ben (Solutions). Marissa, can you confirm the fields we can provide and the typical retention tiers? Below is our initial response that I can attach as formal evidence: 

- Fields included: timestamp (UTC), principal_id (supports SAML subject, or hashed id), action, resource, IP_address, user_agent, session_id, region, and request_id.
- Export formats: CSV (columnar) and JSON lines; we can also provide parquet on request for large exports.
- Default retention: 365 days for standard audit logs. We can support a 2-year flagged retention for PII-sensitive accesses via an archive policy (requires contract addendum).
- PII handling: we support hashed identifiers; salt management is customer-controlled for private deployments; for hosted API we offer deterministic hashing with customer-specific salt stored in KMS.

I'll attach a redacted export (redacted_export_example.zip) and a brief readme (access_evidence_readme.pdf). Ben, can you confirm whether exports will include IP and user_agent (yes/no) and any format caveats?

Hannah

Attachments:
- redacted_export_example.zip (ZIP, 120KB)
- access_evidence_readme.pdf (PDF, 12KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice.nguyen@fincobank.com>, Raj Patel <raj.patel@fincobank.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Mar 2026 09:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit logs & data access evidence request

Hi Alice — quick confirmation from infra/ops: yes, exports include IP_address and user_agent columns. A couple of implementation notes: 

- For CSV exports we escape newline characters in the resource path and provide ISO 8601 UTC timestamps.
- For hashed identifiers we can provide either SHA-256(with salt) or HMAC-SHA256 depending on your preference; we recommend customer-managed salt for the strongest separation.
- We can schedule a secure transfer (SFTP) of the redacted export or share via a short-lived Drive link (we provided one in the Drive folder).

If FinCo wants the 2-year retention for flagged PII accesses we will need a short amendment in the contract; I can draft language and share it to move forward.

Ben Carter
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.inference.com

Attachments included in thread: audit_log_sample.csv, redacted_export_example.zip, access_evidence_readme.pdf
